==Notes==
* The attack speed boost can help to land time sensitive pet attacks ([[Disrupting Lunge]] or [[Bestial Pounce]], for example).

{{anomaly|Cannot be used while [[Activation time|activating]] another [[skill]].}}

== Trivia == 
* During early development of Prophecies, a similar skill, called 'Animal Aggression' already existed. This skill would increase pet attack speed, but not damage, as mentioned by an alpha tester in the Photics e-zine Issue #5<ref>https://photics.com/issues/issue05.pdf</ref>. This skill may have also been changed into [[Call of Haste]].
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[/Skill history|skill revision history]] for details.
